A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LightningRL and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Content can be matched across the changed pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, component ablations, training dynamics, model/block-size experiments, and throughput measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and adds a comparator evaluation and hyperparameter sensitivity experiments.

M1.justification: The losses, decoding procedure, filtering, and Algorithm 1 are retained. Section 3.1 removes v1's contradictory statement that accuracy rewards are not normalized and explicitly presents normalization already contained in v1's Algorithm 1; this does not establish a changed training procedure.

E1.justification: Training still uses MATH, GSM8K, and PrimeIntellect; evaluation retains GSM8K, MATH500, MBPP, and HumanEval. The new sensitivity experiments use the existing GSM8K task, without extending dataset or scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds evaluated Coupled-GRPO results on all four benchmarks. The previous GRPO(traj) row is relabeled DiRL with identical scores and is matched as a retained comparator. Other comparison sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix C.5 adds controlled sweeps of NLL weight, filtering threshold, sampling temperature, and group size on the 8B, block-size-32 GSM8K setup. Existing benchmark protocols and default training settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not explicitly explain a protocol change responsible for the revised main-table AUP values.

E4.justification: New Appendix C.5 and Tables 8–11 substantially extend sensitivity analysis beyond the existing component ablations. They examine anchoring strength, filtering aggressiveness, temperature-dependent rollout quality, and group-size effects on nonzero advantages and collapse. Earlier ablation, scaling, and decoding analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seed-based uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Existing plot shading is retained, and the added sensitivity tables report point summaries without a new uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: AUP values change extensively in Tables 1–4 and Figure 1 despite retained main accuracy and TPF values. LightningRL's average AUP changes from 497.9 to 437.8, and MBPP AUP from 641.6 to 412.9. The GSM8K AUP ordering against d3LLM-LLaDA reverses. v2 also adds Coupled-GRPO and sensitivity results and corrects Table 6's SDAR HumanEval accuracy from 74.4% to 73.5%. These reporting revisions do not establish changed-model performance gains.

T1.justification: No new theorem, proof, assumption, or substantive derivation is introduced. The explicit two-reward equations in Section 3.1 restate normalization already present in v1's Algorithm 1; the remaining mathematical framework is retained.

C1.justification: The introduction revises the headline quantitative claim from 497.9 to 437.8 average AUP. The central contributions, claimed improvement of the accuracy–parallelism frontier, and reported 7.32 average TPF remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix C.5 adds interpretations involving excessive NLL anchoring restricting exploration, stronger filtering reducing sample diversity, and larger groups trading richer learning signals against computational cost. Existing explanations of training collapse, critic instability, and decoding behavior are retained.

D1.justification: Tables 5 and 6 newly specify that AUP uses each model's accuracy near TPF=1 as y_max. Appendix C.5 documents sweep values and fixed controls. Training hyperparameters, hardware, Algorithm 1, and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5.2 and the bibliography remove Huang et al. (2025), Ma et al. (2024), and Zhou et al. (2025). DiRL receives explicit attribution in Table 1 and the trace-aware RL discussion. The broader positioning around jointly optimizing speed and accuracy is retained.

P1.justification: v2 clarifies Section 3.1, corrects grammar, the erroneous expansion of TPF, and a missing Figure 1 reference. It adds acknowledgements and Appendix C.5 and updates publication text, while retaining the main narrative and section organization.

P2.justification: v2 adds four compact sensitivity tables, expands Table 1, reorders baseline bars and legend entries in Figure 1, and revises captions. Tables and references are repaginated more compactly; the existing method diagram and diagnostic plots are retained.

improvement.justification: The added comparator, sensitivity analyses, and clearer normalization description improve evidential coverage and clarity. However, extensive main-table AUP revisions lack an explanation of their calculation changes, and new sensitivity results differ from nominally matching ablations: no-NLL accuracy is 80.7% in Table 3 but 84.7% in Table 8, without documented conditions explaining the difference. These unresolved reliability questions prevent a confident net-quality judgment.
